explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 58 named tracks, releases and catalogue references across Pitchfork's September 10, 2026 Black Bananas review, Resident Advisor's July 17, 2026 veneration for the sacred action review, Rian Treanor's overlooked 2020 File Under UK Metaplasm catalogue, adjacent label pages and current STRANGE GAIT inside-out boundaries; attributed criticism and official release metadata only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Run 160 Fase Bipolar, Confusion, Rene Wise, Loidis and Saint Abdullah & Eomac identities were not recycled.
Previously evaluated, parked, rejected, unresolved and alternate STRANGE GAIT exact identities found in current and archived history were excluded.

Current records supported only by genre tags, prestige, fan reaction or broad release-level language were inspected but not promoted unless exact-track evidence supported a serious later placement test.
No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
sourceWindows: CURRENT CROSS-PRODUCTION-WORLD WINDOW: Pitchfork's September 10, 2026 Bad Bunch review documents Black Bananas turning hip-hop, R&B, dub, rock and pawn-shop electronics into unstable but coherent exact-track collages. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/black-bananas-bad-bunch/

CURRENT ADJACENT / EMERGING WINDOW: Resident Advisor's July 17, 2026 veneration for the sacred action review documents a London improvisation-based collective joining rap, poetry, jazz, electronics and acoustic miniatures through sketches and chance encounters. https://ra.co/reviews/36361

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE WINDOW: Pitchfork's October 6, 2020 File Under UK Metaplasm review documents Rian Treanor pushing functional dance forms through explicit acceleration, sputtering dancehall and gyroscopic pattern modulation. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/rian-treanor-file-under-uk-metaplasm/
